profile.Name: Emperor Tengu
profile.Personality: Impulsive and vain, sure of his own importance. Not stupid, but his judgment fails in hard times. He rules through fear and keeps capable nobles to make himself look strong.
profile.Backstory: He took the throne after the Red Rebellion brought down the previous emperor. Rumor says enemies vanish into a vault beneath Heft.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Expects to be heard; sometimes uses the royal 'we'; mentions Okran only for show.
